how: We read the website of every Houston wedding videographer listed on Lazo (163 listings, 121 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: national videography brands with a Houston landing page, one-stop entertainment chains, photo booth rental companies, and a venue and a planner the search surfaced. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Are the vows and toasts recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or only the camera? Outdoor Houston ceremonies get wind and traffic noise.
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?
Is there an hourly cap, and what does overtime cost if the reception runs late?

picks.name: Pure Plush Photography
picks.blurb: Elizabeth Slack owns and shoots Pure Plush Photo & Video, giving every couple one-on-one attention and letting the day happen without rushing it. Texas weddings of every kind, from a Houston base.

picks.name: Genovese Ashford Studios
picks.blurb: A small collective of photographers and filmmakers founded by Chris Genovese in 2007, shooting primarily documentary style and staging as little as possible. Genovese Studios covers Houston, Galveston and Louisiana from El Lago.

picks.name: EP Films | Handcrafted Wedding Videography
picks.blurb: EP Films makes honest, emotional wedding films, no trends and no fluff in their words, with a team that assigns one person as your contact from the first chat. Based in Montgomery, serving Houston, Austin, Dallas, San Antonio and all of Texas.

picks.name: Nate Messarra Photography
picks.blurb: Nate and Alex are a husband-and-wife duo shooting photo and video as one team, so you walk into the day with both covered. Nate's start was selling digital cameras at Best Buy as a teenager; the site is built around couples' own words about working with them.

picks.name: Good Omen Photo & Films
picks.blurb: Good Omen's films are cinematic with an editorial edge and Super 8 in the mix, made by Val and JB, a married team in Cypress. Because of the hands-on process they reserve space for just one featured wedding film per date, and collections are printed from $4,900.

picks.name: AB Motion Photo & Video
picks.blurb: Blanca and Alex founded AB Motion Video+Photo 17 years ago and run it as a family operation out of Houston, kids often in tow. The site publishes its videography and photography pricing and collections rather than making you ask.

picks.name: True Creations Videography
picks.blurb: True Creations Videography is Jordan Zale's Sugar Land production company, making timeless wedding films meant to be felt, not just watched. The site states 2026 pricing starts at $6,500, with packages you can purchase directly online.

picks.name: Blue Our Photo + Films
picks.blurb: Sarah photographs and Benji films, a Houston husband-and-wife team who say they are very different behind the camera and work better for it. Editorial, emotion-driven storytelling for Texas couples who want to enjoy the day.

picks.name: Epic Photography
picks.blurb: Epic Photos + Films is a small team that has documented weddings through photos and films for more than ten years, bringing energy, direction and planning help so couples can stay present. Houston and the surrounding areas.

picks.name: Flash Forward Productions + Media
picks.blurb: Photography and cinematography from one company, with combination packages for couples who want both. Flash Forward has covered over 1,000 weddings since 2009 and works the Houston-Galveston corridor from Santa Fe.

picks.name: Exquisite Wedding Photo & Video
picks.blurb: Exquisite pairs wedding photography with cinematic films, over a decade in, and pitches affordable excellence with no hidden fees. Every package includes free travel all over Texas and a full copyright release; based in Cypress.

picks.name: Amor Wedding Films | Houston Wedding Photographer and Videographer
picks.blurb: Amor Wedding Films describes itself as founded by a filmmaker and built on artistry, emotion and precision, aiming to capture the essence of a couple rather than just the events. Houston wedding videography, photography and engagement sessions.
